- Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
- Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
- Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why
- Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off
- Fixed `~/.claude.json` sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save
- Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
- Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code
- Fixed picking a cloud session in `/teleport` replacing your open conversation: the pick now starts a new session, as `/clear` does, and `/resume` brings the old one back
- Fixed `/usage-credits` asking Pro and Max users to log in again after opening the browser, and the link disappearing after 8 seconds if the browser doesn't open and a task stops for usage credits
- Fixed `/usage` saying usage credits are off when they had run out or reached the monthly limit, and `/model` not telling Pro and Max users when that limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits
- Fixed the spend limit menu showing your spend as your monthly limit and wrapping its rows under the pointer in narrow windows
- Fixed a status line script that prints without end freezing the prompt and using gigabytes of memory
- Fixed an empty, frozen screen after approving managed settings while the --resume picker, the trust dialog or another set-up screen was waiting
- Fixed choosing Default in `/model` replacing your saved model with your organization's default when the Default row already showed your saved model
- Fixed an MCP server being signed in again after you cleared its authentication while a token refresh was running
- Fixed background MCP tasks that stalled after a slow reconnect: Claude Code now reconnects most HTTP MCP servers by itself when one is left on an older protocol version
- Fixed PDFs, images and `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` files that MCP servers or websites send as `application/octet-stream` being saved as .bin, which kept Claude from reading the PDFs and images
- Fixed `/code-review <pr number>` sometimes reviewing the checked-out branch instead of the pull request without saying so: it now reads the pull request with `gh pr diff`, or says when it can't
- Fixed `/code-review` stopping at a permission prompt, on most models, to look for a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` that doesn't exist
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--push-outcome-on-release` sometimes deleting a session's branch on the git host
- Fixed Code Mode hiding a script's finished edits and the stopped command after Esc, and losing them on exit
- Fixed a runaway loop in Code Mode filling the machine's memory; it is now stopped at a limit
- Fixed a background agent running on when it was stopped while it was being resumed
- Fixed background shell commands using memory for the earlier conversation until they exit
- Fixed Remote Control using memory for the earlier conversation after a compaction or `/clear` in sessions run by Claude Desktop, IDEs or the SDK
- Fixed Stop not ending a request in Claude Desktop sessions on Bedrock while it waits on a hung AWS credential_process or sign-in call
- Fixed Claude sometimes failing to send you a file on its first try on Opus 4.8 and Opus 5
- Fixed Claude not being told that a connected MCP server's tools could not be loaded, and taking it for a server with no tools, in sessions with tool search
- Fixed `claude mcp login` and `/mcp` saying a service doesn't accept sign-ins from Claude Code when the service's client registration had been retired (HTTP 410 Gone)
- Fixed another case of claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" while a session was still running on macOS
- Fixed auto mode asking for manual approval to `rm` a symlink that points outside the working directory or at itself
- Fixed `/sandbox` on Linux listing `allowUnixSockets` entries as allowed: they don't open those sockets there, and `/sandbox` now says so
- Fixed pressing Esc twice to clear a mistyped code ending the sign-in in `/install-github-app`
- Remote Control: Fixed sessions going back to their first effort level after a restart while the app still showed the level you picked (not yet for sessions that start in Ultracode)
- Fixed a removed plugin's MCP server staying connected in headless sessions after `reload_plugins` or when the account's plugin list drops it
- Fixed the Claude Docs connector's tools going missing when a plugin or MCP server at the same address failed to connect, and its error wrongly suggesting `/login`
- Fixed a new skills, commands or agents folder being missed when `--add-dir` names the working directory or Claude Code starts in the home folder
- Fixed sessions started from a pre-warmed process ignoring the `autoCompactWindow` setting in the project's `.claude/settings.json`
- Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` staying in effect in a running session after it is removed from settings.json
- Fixed the Agent tool's `effort` parameter being ignored for named teammates in agent teams
- Fixed `/auto-mode-setup` ignoring recent auto mode denials when it scans a project for rules to suggest; it may now offer allow rules from them, and you review each before it's saved
- Fixed a false "Couldn't save this change" warning after adding a permission rule or directory in a subfolder or worktree whose own `.claude/settings.local.json` is unreadable or malformed
- Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude to run a network proxy check after a failed request, which auto mode then blocked
- Fixed headless rewind and fork going ahead while a message sent right after a model change still waited on it
- Fixed Claude not being told when a background task was stopped while a cloud session was restarting
- Fixed `/team-onboarding` reporting a guide as shared on Team and Enterprise plans when the server refused the upload
- Fixed panels and questions being cut off at the prompt in fullscreen, `/help`, history search and the background tasks list losing rows or titles in short windows, and tables wrapping in dialogs
- Fixed resumed sessions showing "Rejected" or "Declined" for edits, questions and plans that were cut off when the session ended
- Fixed `/passes` showing the wrong number of passes after a server error, and offering usage credits for sharing when no guest passes are left
- Fixed `claude --help` output being cut short when piped to another program
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` turning on "Use Option as Meta key" in Terminal.app on macOS 27, and tips there suggesting Option+Enter instead of Shift+Enter
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed setup failing on Git LFS repositories cloned through Anthropic-managed git; sessions now start on pointer files, and `git lfs pull` fetches the content
- Fixed sessions on self-hosted environments not starting from a git remote with an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates or a GHE.com SSH user; an unresolved alias's error gives two git commands
- Fixed remote MCP servers in self-hosted runner sessions staying without tools, or (over https) disconnected, after a timeout or network error
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as having stopped responding while Claude Code was still starting
- Fixed Code Mode keeping in memory every large text file that code read, and memory growing each time a background subagent was woken
- Fixed Code Mode stopping a script at its ten-minute limit while an MCP form, an MCP link prompt or a prompt that always asks was waiting for an answer
- Fixed Code Mode scripts receiving a "moved to the background" message as data from most MCP calls over two minutes: the script now waits up to ten minutes, then gets an error
- Fixed mods that list only some tools silently turning Code Mode off; such a mod no longer keeps it off, so use managed settings for that
- Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn when the tool was called from a script that Claude waits for
- Fixed a Code Mode script's `let x;` keeping the value that an earlier script gave `x`
- Fixed a Code Mode script's call with no argument failing with a missing-parameter error on tools that need none
- Fixed Code Mode scripts losing access to tools through `tools` in sessions with more than 4,096 tools
- Fixed the `/code-review` findings card often showing "high" for a review that ran at medium, on most models
- Fixed key hints in permission prompts, questions, `/model` and `/rewind` ignoring `keybindings.json`
- Fixed auto-scroll, the PR status badge, the auto-compact warning and the ultracode tag not following the `/config` switches that control them in a running session
- Fixed a custom cancel key not working in `/add-dir`, `/tui` feedback and the save-workflow form
- Fixed arrow keys in the save-workflow form moving the selection in the workflow view behind it
- Fixed `/config` saying nothing, or "dismissed", after changing many settings
- Fixed Read and @-mentions showing one line too many for files that end in a newline
- Fixed `/status` not naming the model that opusplan and haiku use in plan mode
- Fixed `claude doctor` advising a Keychain unlock inside a macOS sandbox, where unlocking can't help
- Fixed the "Jump to bottom" pill staying hidden after copying text and scrolling away, the row under it going blank when its label changed, and quick PageUp presses scrolling too far in fullscreen
- Fixed a screen update sometimes being skipped when memory is low
- Fixed long code blocks losing a blank line and repeating another in scrollback
- Fixed prompt suggestions sometimes showing placeholder text such as `_(no suggestion)_`
- Fixed the line about earlier messages on resume blaming a damaged file when the file was intact
- Fixed characters disappearing from the prompt when its text held a color code that sets several styles and a keyword or command was highlighted
- Fixed `/rename` and `UserPromptSubmit` hook titles in `claude remote-control` sessions not showing on claude.ai and mobile
- Fixed the Remote Control diff listing a file twice when the branch renamed it and it was then edited
- Improved the automatic clean-up of old sessions on computers with managed settings
- Improved `/tui` and other in-place restarts to wait briefly for a login refresh, so they are less likely to sign you out
- Improved memory use in long sessions that edit many files, and in long Claude Desktop sessions on macOS and Linux with many large MCP tool results
- Windows: Improved start-up and the first search on PCs where Claude Code's search program starts slowly
- Improved auto mode's handling of a short reply such as "yes" to Claude's question when telemetry is off, behind a gateway to the Anthropic API, or on Microsoft Foundry
- Improved memory use of idle Claude Desktop and SDK sessions after a long turn, and after `--resume` or `--continue` of a session that holds screenshots or large tool results
- Improved how fast a Claude Desktop Code session with Remote Control on is ready for the next message after an answer
- Improved cloud sessions to retry plugins that failed to download at startup
- Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a script makes thousands of tool calls
- Improved Code Mode: after starting a subagent, Claude now gets the same guidance on waiting as outside Code Mode
- Updated computer use on macOS to newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and some apps have less access
- Changed saved scheduled tasks: in new signed-in sessions, most saved by earlier versions need scheduling again, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them
- Changed `/code-review` with no target on most models to review the whole branch against the default branch, and fixed it losing the diff on multi-commit branches
- Changed auto mode to run `git status` less often so most requests wait less in large repositories; a git command that discards changes may be blocked until the working tree is checked
- Changed `/code-review <pr number> --fix`, and `/code-review` given a pull request URL, to stop without reviewing when `gh pr diff` is refused or fails
- Changed 'Exit and stop tasks' to end this session's scheduled tasks so they don't run again on resume, unless you exit while Claude is responding
- Changed some teammate panes to start through /bin/sh, so they may not read shell start-up files
- Changed computer use on macOS to give up on an app launch that has not finished after 30 seconds
- Gateway: Changed the start-up warning shown while `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty to a notice at every start, boxed in text logs: never expose the gateway to the public internet
- Self-hosted runner: Changed a second host name's clone of the same owner/name to go under `_repos/clones/<host>/` in the base folder; no clone moves
- Self-hosted runner: Changed repositories with unusual characters in their address path to clone anew in a new folder; rules and volumes naming the old one stop applying, and the old clone stays put
- Self-hosted runner: Changed `--repository-folder` to take most folders in the base folder at `--capacity 1` (above 1, one there stops start-up); another repository's session overlapping one is refused
- Changed Code Mode so a PreToolUse hook that errors no longer refuses a script's tool call, as outside Code Mode; set `"onFailure": "block"` on a command, HTTP or MCP tool hook that must refuse
- Changed Code Mode to refuse a script's read of a line range over 256 MiB, which could use gigabytes of memory, and fixed reads of very long lines timing out
- Changed Code Mode to also start when telemetry, nonessential traffic or feature flags are turned off; an administrator can keep it off in managed settings
- Changed Code Mode to run a script that declares its own `log`, `preview` or `sleep`, which it used to refuse
- Changed macOS login renewal to test the Keychain with a `Claude Code-write-check` item
- Changed the `/tasks` header and the footer's background count to one number covering shells, monitors, MCP calls, agents, workflows and scheduled tasks
- Changed Stop and SubagentStop hooks to list a Monitor's script as `monitor`, not `shell`, in `background_tasks`
- Removed 2.1.326's automatic retry at the limit named in a `max_tokens` error; behind a gateway whose model takes fewer output tokens, set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to that limit
- [VSCode] Added a line above the message box after you decline the trust prompt, with Review trust to bring the prompt back without reloading the window
- [VSCode] Fixed being signed out of Claude Code in every window and terminal when the sign-in server took 10 to 30 seconds to answer the extension's token refresh
- [VSCode] Fixed keys pressed while an input method (IME) is composing moving focus on or declining a permission prompt, running menu rows and closing dialogs (anthropics/claude-code#106358)
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for Bash, Edit, Write and other built-in tools not showing why a safety check asks
- [VSCode] Fixed a half-written plan comment being lost or moved to another passage, and an input method's Enter sending the comment, ending a session rename or picking an @-mentioned file
- [VSCode] Fixed the limit banner not saying when usage credits are in use, and the session survey covering that banner and the usage credits card
- [VSCode] Fixed screen readers not announcing a permission request that arrived while the Account & Usage dialog was open until that dialog was closed
- [VSCode] Fixed a proposed-edit diff tab staying open, with an Accept button that did nothing, after its terminal Claude Code session disconnected
- [VSCode] Fixed short tool inputs and outputs cut off at the panel's edge with no way to read the rest (they now open in an editor tab), and dragging to select text also opening one
- [VSCode] Fixed the Up key putting an earlier message over text that an input method (IME) is composing in the message box (anthropics/claude-code#101294)
- [VSCode] Fixed dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat inserting nothing on VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, and the drop highlight vanishing with a false "Hold Shift" hint
- [VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt moving keyboard focus away from the details you were scrolling as its buttons switched on
- [VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening in another editor group when `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` is off (anthropics/claude-code#108884)
- [VSCode] Fixed ranges written with a single tilde (`3~5 … 7~10`) losing their tildes and showing struck-through text between them; only `~~text~~` is struck through now
- [VSCode] Fixed dictation errors wrapping into a narrow column, the spinner turning while a question card waits, and a NUL symbol after each letter in the output of a failed UTF-16 command
- [VSCode] Changed Down to stop at the last item of a permission prompt instead of wrapping to Yes
- [VSCode] Changed command output to show hidden characters and control sequences other than plain colors as symbols, so Persian, Khmer, Lao, Sinhala and Malayalam text can look broken or out of order

- Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a script makes thousands of tool calls
- Improved Code Mode: after starting a subagent, Claude now gets the same guidance on waiting as outside Code Mode
- Updated computer use on macOS to newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and some apps have less access
- Changed saved scheduled tasks: in new signed-in sessions, most saved by earlier versions need scheduling again, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them
- Changed `/code-review` with no target on most models to review the whole branch against the default branch, and fixed it losing the diff on multi-commit branches
- Changed auto mode to run `git status` less often so most requests wait less in large repositories; a git command that discards changes may be blocked until the working tree is checked
- Changed `/code-review <pr number> --fix`, and `/code-review` given a pull request URL, to stop without reviewing when `gh pr diff` is refused or fails
- Changed 'Exit and stop tasks' to end this session's scheduled tasks so they don't run again on resume, unless you exit while Claude is responding
- Changed some teammate panes to start through /bin/sh, so they may not read shell start-up files
- Changed computer use on macOS to give up on an app launch that has not finished after 30 seconds
- Gateway: Changed the start-up warning shown while `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty to a notice at every start, boxed in text logs: never expose the gateway to the public internet
- Self-hosted runner: Changed a second host name's clone of the same owner/name to go under `_repos/clones/<host>/` in the base folder; no clone moves
- Self-hosted runner: Changed repositories with unusual characters in their address path to clone anew in a new folder; rules and volumes naming the old one stop applying, and the old clone stays put
- Self-hosted runner: Changed `--repository-folder` to take most folders in the base folder at `--capacity 1` (above 1, one there stops start-up); another repository's session overlapping one is refused
- Changed Code Mode so a PreToolUse hook that errors no longer refuses a script's tool call, as outside Code Mode; set `"onFailure": "block"` on a command, HTTP or MCP tool hook that must refuse
- Changed Code Mode to refuse a script's read of a line range over 256 MiB, which could use gigabytes of memory, and fixed reads of very long lines timing out
- Changed Code Mode to also start when telemetry, nonessential traffic or feature flags are turned off; an administrator can keep it off in managed settings
- Changed Code Mode to run a script that declares its own `log`, `preview` or `sleep`, which it used to refuse
- Changed macOS login renewal to test the Keychain with a `Claude Code-write-check` item
- Changed the `/tasks` header and the footer's background count to one number covering shells, monitors, MCP calls, agents, workflows and scheduled tasks
- Changed Stop and SubagentStop hooks to list a Monitor's script as `monitor`, not `shell`, in `background_tasks`
- Removed 2.1.326's automatic retry at the limit named in a `max_tokens` error; behind a gateway whose model takes fewer output tokens, set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to that limit
- [VSCode] Added a line above the message box after you decline the trust prompt, with Review trust to bring the prompt back without reloading the window
- [VSCode] Fixed being signed out of Claude Code in every window and terminal when the sign-in server took 10 to 30 seconds to answer the extension's token refresh
- [VSCode] Fixed keys pressed while an input method (IME) is composing moving focus on or declining a permission prompt, running menu rows and closing dialogs (anthropics/claude-code#106358)
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for Bash, Edit, Write and other built-in tools not showing why a safety check asks
- [VSCode] Fixed a half-written plan comment being lost or moved to another passage, and an input method's Enter sending the comment, ending a session rename or picking an @-mentioned file
- [VSCode] Fixed the limit banner not saying when usage credits are in use, and the session survey covering that banner and the usage credits card
- [VSCode] Fixed screen readers not announcing a permission request that arrived while the Account & Usage dialog was open until that dialog was closed
- [VSCode] Fixed a proposed-edit diff tab staying open, with an Accept button that did nothing, after its terminal Claude Code session disconnected
- [VSCode] Fixed short tool inputs and outputs cut off at the panel's edge with no way to read the rest (they now open in an editor tab), and dragging to select text also opening one
- [VSCode] Fixed the Up key putting an earlier message over text that an input method (IME) is composing in the message box (anthropics/claude-code#101294)
- [VSCode] Fixed dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat inserting nothing on VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, and the drop highlight vanishing with a false "Hold Shift" hint
- [VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt moving keyboard focus away from the details you were scrolling as its buttons switched on
- [VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening in another editor group when `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` is off (anthropics/claude-code#108884)
- [VSCode] Fixed ranges written with a single tilde (`3~5 … 7~10`) losing their tildes and showing struck-through text between them; only `~~text~~` is struck through now
- [VSCode] Fixed dictation errors wrapping into a narrow column, the spinner turning while a question card waits, and a NUL symbol after each letter in the output of a failed UTF-16 command
- [VSCode] Changed Down to stop at the last item of a permission prompt instead of wrapping to Yes
- [VSCode] Changed command output to show hidden characters and control sequences other than plain colors as symbols, so Persian, Khmer, Lao, Sinhala and Malayalam text can look broken or out of order

rawIngestions.titleRaw: huggingface/transformers v5.24.0 released
rawIngestions.contentRaw: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. It uses a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved sliding-window and full attention layers. A shared block of layers is applied repeatedly, so Dory can spend more compute per token. The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dory) | [Paper (nGPT)](https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.01131) * Add Dory model support (#50099) by @shan18 ### HY4-VL HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation. It supports dynamic-resolution visual inputs and uses multimodal rotary position embeddings (mRoPE) to represent temporal and spatial positions. It builds on the Qwen2-VL design and shares its vision patch merger with HunYuan-VL. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4_vl) * Add HY4-VL (#50877) by @vasqu ### Omnilingual ASR Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages. Each model pairs a Wav2Vec2-style audio encoder with one of two heads: * **CTC** (`OmniASRForCTC`): a linear projection to the vocabulary, decoded non-autoregressively with greedy CTC. * **Audio language model** (`OmniASRForConditionalGeneration`): audio embeddings are projected into a Llama decoder that generates the transcription. It optionally takes a language code (e.g. `"eng_Latn"`), which generally improves transcription quality. Both variants come in 300M, 1B, 3B and 7B sizes. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr) | [CTC Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr_ctc) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2511.09690) * Adding Omnilingual ASR models (#43265) by @ebezzam ### Lara Mini Lara Mini is a multilingual base language model from Translated with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters per token. It is a hybrid of linear-time recurrent layers, sliding-window attention and a few global attention layers, each followed by a fine-grained mixture of experts. The weights are released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (non-commercial use) in a gated repository. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lara_mini) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2611.16956) * Add Lara Mini (#50819) by @ValeGian ### SarvamMLA SarvamMLA is the architecture of Sarvam-105B, a 105B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Sarvam AI. It combines Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with sparse MoE routing: 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. It uses sigmoid routing with group-based top-k selection and YaRN rotary embeddings for contexts up to 131K tokens. The architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, with a custom configuration. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_mla) * Add SarvamMLA model (sarvamai/sarvam-105b) (#44569) by @aashay-sarvam ### SarvamMoE SarvamMoE is the architecture of Sarvam-30B, Sarvam AI's 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model. It uses grouped-query attention with QK normalization, and 128 routed experts with 6 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. The architecture is the same as GLM-4-MoE, so the auto classes load it with the GLM-4-MoE implementation and only `SarvamMoEConfig` is specific to SarvamMoE. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_moe) * Add SarvamMoE (sarvamai/sarvam-30b) (#51023) by @hmellor ### EXAONE EXAONE covers the EXAONE 3.0, EXAONE 3.5 and EXAONE Deep language models from LG AI Research. Their architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load them with `LlamaModel` and `LlamaForCausalLM`, and only `ExaoneConfig` is specific to EXAONE. The released checkpoints are renamed to the Llama names when loading and back when saving, so they no longer need `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/exaone) * Add EXAONE (#50966) by @hmellor ### Model updates * **Ling 3.1 Flash** now loads natively through `BailingHybrid`, like Ling 3.0 in v5.20.0 (#49737) by @icavan * **Beam** gains a `BeamForTokenClassification` head (#50634) by @AymenKallala ## Breaking changes ### Cache renaming: `past_key_values` / `cache_params` → `cache` (#50585, #50730) `past_key_values` and `cache_params` are renamed to `cache` across the library. The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below. * 🚨🚨 Rename `past_key_values`/`cache_params` to `cache` (#50585) by @Cyrilvallez * Bump minimal peft version for cache name compatibility (#50730) by @Cyrilvallez Attention models used to call their cache `past_key_values`, while Mamba-style and linear-attention models called it `cache_params`. Hybrid models therefore had to juggle two names for the same object. There is now a single name, `cache`, everywhere: model `forward` signatures, `generate`, `prepare_inputs_for_generation`, the masking utilities, and every `ModelOutput`. ```python # Before outputs = model(input_ids, past_key_values=past_key_values, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.past_key_values # Now outputs = model(input_ids, cache=cache, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.cache ``` * **Fully backward compatible for now**: `past_key_values=` / `cache_params=` are renamed to `cache` automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning. Model `forward` and `prepare_inputs_for_generation` accept the old names until **v5.40.0**, and `generate` accepts them until **v6.0.0**. Passing both an old name and `cache` raises a `ValueError`. * **Outputs too**: `outputs.past_key_values`, `outputs.cache_params` and `outputs["past_key_values"]` still return the cache. Output classes can also still be built with the old field names (e.g. `CausalLMOutputWithPast(past_key_values=...)`), so most remote-code models keep working unchanged. * **Custom code**: models defined outside the library should rename their arguments to `cache`. Layers now call `cache.update(key_states, value_states, layer_idx, kwargs=kwargs)`, so custom `Cache` subclasses that override `update` should accept the extra `kwargs` argument. 🚨 `peft>=0.22.0` is now required. 📚 Docs: ### Multimodal Outputs Generative multimodal models now return shared output classes (`MultimodalBaseModelOutputWithPast`, `MultimodalCausalLMOutputWithPast`, and their MoE variants) instead of one output class per model. Code that checks for a model-specific output class should switch to these. * 🚨 Multimodal Model Output for generative LMs (#50379) by @zucchini-nlp `modeling_attn_mask_utils.py` has been removed. Every function in it had been deprecated in favor of `transformers.masking_utils`. Remote-code models that still import `_prepare_4d_causal_attention_mask` or `AttentionMaskConverter` from it must move to `transformers.masking_utils`. ### Other things * Remove deprecated and unused older mask API file (#50728) by @Cyrilvallez LayoutLMv3 (and the PP-DocLayoutV2 reading-order model that shares its code) now go through the attention interface, so SDPA and flex attention are supported. The relative position bias is built once per forward pass and passed to attention as `position_bias`. * 🚨 LayoutLMv3: support SDPA through the attention interface, build the relative position bias once (#50688) by @14H034160212 ## Cache Beyond the rename, this release adds static-cache support to assisted decoding and fixes `generate` with flex attention and a static cache. `StaticCache` now allocates values with the value states' dtype, and the cache is kept under activation checkpointing when gradients are off. The `is_linear` / `is_croppable` properties are fixed for hybrid linear/full-attention models, BigBird block-sparse decoding works with a KV cache, and KV sharing is restored for the Gemma 4 assistants. * Support static cache in assisted decoding (#49415) by @jiqing-feng * Simplify cache handling in generate (#50910) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix generate with flex attention and a static cache (#50864) by @tarekziade * Allocate the StaticCache values with the value states' dtype (#49554) by @qgallouedec * Keep the cache under activation checkpointing when gradients are off (#50890) by @qgallouedec * [cache] Fix is_linear property to correctly remove hybrid layers (#51030) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix is_croppable property for mixed linear-full attention classes (#51028) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix BigBird block-sparse decoding with a KV cache (#49984) by @jiqing-feng * fix(gemma4): Restore KV sharing for the Gemma 4 assistants and their targets (#50531) by @harshaljanjani * Fix Dory vocabulary resizing, loop validation, and last-loop static caching (#50982) by @shan18 * Fix device placement in `test_bc_cache_name_{forward,generate}` (#50757) by @ydshieh * Update test_dynamic_cache_hard expected values for A10G (#50822) by @ydshieh ## Generation Generation fixes cover sampled beam search (candidates are sorted again before finalization), constrained sampling (batch IDs are preserved), `generate` on MPS with encoder-decoder models, and `TextStreamer`, which no longer drops spaces or lags on text without spaces such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `StopStringCriteria` initializes faster, and its cache now actually hits. * Restore sorting of sampled beam candidates before finalization (#50754) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(generate): preserve batch IDs in constrained sampling (#50883) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Fix generate for mps and encoder-decoder models (#51032) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix TextStreamer dropping spaces sometimes (#51036) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix long lagging when streaming text without spaces and NJK chars (#36708) by @CNSeniorious000 * Speed up StopStringCriteria init and fix its cache never hitting (#50780) by @TheNetherWatcher ## Continuous batching Continuous batching now works under `torch.inference_mode()` and finds sharded key/value projections under any decoder path. The per-token memory estimate scales with the TP size, warmup handles async and static inputs correctly, and an out-of-bounds error in the top-k processor is fixed. * [CB] Scale the per-token memory estimate by the TP size (#48566) by @qgallouedec * Continuous batching: find the sharded key/value projections under any decoder path (#50366) by @qgallouedec * Fix continuous batching under torch.inference_mode() (#50863) by @tarekziade * [CB] Re-order the warmup block so async warms both sets of inputs (#50868) by @remi-or * Wait for each warmup forward before the next one rewrites the static inputs (#50353) by @qgallouedec * Fix out-of-bounds error in continuous batching top-k processor (#50282) by @khush-patel-09 * [CB] Replace test prompts with less ambiguous ones (#50876) by @remi-or ## Chat templates, parsing and serving Chat parsing gets a new `python-call-list` content parser, better handling of bare keys and duplicate XML arguments, and three further parser fixes. `apply_chat_template` accepts message objects, and assistant masks are correct with left truncation. `transformers serve` handles a missing Hub cache, lists loaded models in `/v1/models`, keeps local paths containing `@`, and keeps assistant content when `tool_calls` is empty. * [Chat Parsing] Add `python-call-list` content parser (#50619) by @nico-martin * [Chat Parsing] Quote bare keys that have whitespace around them with `unquoted_keys` (#50917) by @gagan-baghel * [Chat Parsing] Preserve array values when merging duplicate XML arguments (#50760) by @crunz-ailab * Fix three chat parsing bugs (#50655) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix apply_chat_template with message objects (#50818) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix assistant tokens mask with left truncation (#50758) by @yibol9768-alt * fix(chat templating): isolate concurrent assistant tracking (#50673) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Just a small improvement in jinja (#50635) by @zucchini-nlp * Accept argument types in parentheses in get_json_schema docstrings (#50745) by @miinimal * [serve] Handle missing Hub cache and include loaded models in /v1/models (#50663) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Preserve local model paths containing '@' in ModelManager (#50662) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Keep assistant content when tool_calls is null or empty (#50707) by @AabhasK ## Pipelines Multimodal pipelines now accept media-only inputs and string assistant prefills, keep Mistral prefills in Voxtral, stop mutating generation kwargs, and return chat messages as `input_text` when returning tensors. `pipeline` also respects a `device_map` that targets a single device. * fix(pipelines): support media-only inputs in AnyToAnyPipeline (#50856) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): support string assistant prefill in multimodal full-t… (#50679) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix: preserve Mistral prefill in Voxtral and multimodal pipelines (#50624) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): avoid mutating multimodal generation kwargs (#50786) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Return the chat messages as input_text when multimodal pipelines return tensors (#50816) by @burrows99 * Fix `pipeline` ignoring `device_map` when it targets a single device (#50645) by @wanhakim ## Vision Vision fixes cover Muse Glimmer's embedding order, GotOCR2 and Emu3 image sizes, Kimi video inputs, NemotronH Omni video forwarding, SAM3 RoPE precision in bf16, and DETR-family configs with `dilation=None`. SigLIP2 and LFM2-VL now process all images at once with tensor ops. Flash Attention is turned off for multimodal models whose image mask it would drop. * Fix Muse Glimmer vision embedding order (#50847) by @sid-rp * Fix GotOCR2 image size (#50810) by @guarin * Fix Emu3 image sizes after channel format conversion (#50615) by @stefanielizeth73-art * Kimi video fix (#50633) by @zucchini-nlp * Fix NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 video forwarding and MTP vision norm weight conversion (#49839) by @meatybobby * Keep SAM3's RoPE positions in fp32 when loading in bf16 (#50938) by @qgallouedec * Fix loading DETR-family configs that store dilation=None (#50934) by @sibisrinivasb * SigLIP2: compute the position-embedding resize for all images with tensor ops (#50736) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: run the projector on all images at once (#50734) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: integration expectations after #50734 (A10, MI300X) (#50923) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * Turn off Flash Attention support for multimodal models whose image mask it drops (#50724) by @albertvillanova ## Audio Audio fixes cover the OmniASR CTC blank token, Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs, Qwen3-ASR's `truncation=False` default, PeAudioVideo loading with timm 1.0.31, and the audio training examples. * Fix OmniASR CTC blank token ID (#51040) by @taking-lying-flat * Add missing past_key_values deprecation decorator to OmniASRForCondit… (#50983) by @RyanMullins * Fix Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs forwarding (#50616) by @remote-controlled-man * Restore `truncation=False` default for Qwen3-ASR audio (#50740) by @hmellor * Fixes PeAudioVideo model loading with timm 1.0.31. In that version, t… (#50862) by @sywangyi * FIx audio training examples. (#50672) by @ebezzam ## Quantization Dequantized models are now saved without the quantizer's weight conversions, and the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint are cast to the model's dtype. The quantization docs also get a standard template for each method. * Save dequantized models without the quantizer's weight conversions (#50271) by @qgallouedec * Cast the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint to the model's dtype (#50595) by @qgallouedec * Update inkling2 quant config (#50829) by @guarin * [docs] Standard template for quantization methods (#50848) by @stevhliu ## Parallelization FSDP2 modules are resharded before the optimizer is created, pipeline parallelism spreads layers more evenly, and TP sharding of tied weights is fixed. * Reshard FSDP2 modules before creating the optimizer (#50535) by @qgallouedec * [perf] Spread layer over PP more evenly (#50693) by @francesco-bertolotti * Fixes an issue related to TP sharding of tied weights (#50272) by @tengomucho ## Exporters Exported ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without `trust_remote_code`. Pickled `.pt2` programs, which can run arbitrary code when loaded, now require `trust_remote_code=True`. * Exporters: ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without trust_remote_code (#50886) by release.name: Release v5.24.0
release.body: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. It uses a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved sliding-window and full attention layers. A shared block of layers is applied repeatedly, so Dory can spend more compute per token. The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dory) | [Paper (nGPT)](https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.01131) * Add Dory model support (#50099) by @shan18 ### HY4-VL HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation. It supports dynamic-resolution visual inputs and uses multimodal rotary position embeddings (mRoPE) to represent temporal and spatial positions. It builds on the Qwen2-VL design and shares its vision patch merger with HunYuan-VL. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4_vl) * Add HY4-VL (#50877) by @vasqu ### Omnilingual ASR Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages. Each model pairs a Wav2Vec2-style audio encoder with one of two heads: * **CTC** (`OmniASRForCTC`): a linear projection to the vocabulary, decoded non-autoregressively with greedy CTC. * **Audio language model** (`OmniASRForConditionalGeneration`): audio embeddings are projected into a Llama decoder that generates the transcription. It optionally takes a language code (e.g. `"eng_Latn"`), which generally improves transcription quality. Both variants come in 300M, 1B, 3B and 7B sizes. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr) | [CTC Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr_ctc) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2511.09690) * Adding Omnilingual ASR models (#43265) by @ebezzam ### Lara Mini Lara Mini is a multilingual base language model from Translated with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters per token. It is a hybrid of linear-time recurrent layers, sliding-window attention and a few global attention layers, each followed by a fine-grained mixture of experts. The weights are released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (non-commercial use) in a gated repository. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lara_mini) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2611.16956) * Add Lara Mini (#50819) by @ValeGian ### SarvamMLA SarvamMLA is the architecture of Sarvam-105B, a 105B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Sarvam AI. It combines Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with sparse MoE routing: 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. It uses sigmoid routing with group-based top-k selection and YaRN rotary embeddings for contexts up to 131K tokens. The architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, with a custom configuration. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_mla) * Add SarvamMLA model (sarvamai/sarvam-105b) (#44569) by @aashay-sarvam ### SarvamMoE SarvamMoE is the architecture of Sarvam-30B, Sarvam AI's 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model. It uses grouped-query attention with QK normalization, and 128 routed experts with 6 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. The architecture is the same as GLM-4-MoE, so the auto classes load it with the GLM-4-MoE implementation and only `SarvamMoEConfig` is specific to SarvamMoE. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_moe) * Add SarvamMoE (sarvamai/sarvam-30b) (#51023) by @hmellor ### EXAONE EXAONE covers the EXAONE 3.0, EXAONE 3.5 and EXAONE Deep language models from LG AI Research. Their architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load them with `LlamaModel` and `LlamaForCausalLM`, and only `ExaoneConfig` is specific to EXAONE. The released checkpoints are renamed to the Llama names when loading and back when saving, so they no longer need `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/exaone) * Add EXAONE (#50966) by @hmellor ### Model updates * **Ling 3.1 Flash** now loads natively through `BailingHybrid`, like Ling 3.0 in v5.20.0 (#49737) by @icavan * **Beam** gains a `BeamForTokenClassification` head (#50634) by @AymenKallala ## Breaking changes ### Cache renaming: `past_key_values` / `cache_params` → `cache` (#50585, #50730) `past_key_values` and `cache_params` are renamed to `cache` across the library. The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below. * 🚨🚨 Rename `past_key_values`/`cache_params` to `cache` (#50585) by @Cyrilvallez * Bump minimal peft version for cache name compatibility (#50730) by @Cyrilvallez Attention models used to call their cache `past_key_values`, while Mamba-style and linear-attention models called it `cache_params`. Hybrid models therefore had to juggle two names for the same object. There is now a single name, `cache`, everywhere: model `forward` signatures, `generate`, `prepare_inputs_for_generation`, the masking utilities, and every `ModelOutput`. ```python # Before outputs = model(input_ids, past_key_values=past_key_values, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.past_key_values # Now outputs = model(input_ids, cache=cache, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.cache ``` * **Fully backward compatible for now**: `past_key_values=` / `cache_params=` are renamed to `cache` automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning. Model `forward` and `prepare_inputs_for_generation` accept the old names until **v5.40.0**, and `generate` accepts them until **v6.0.0**. Passing both an old name and `cache` raises a `ValueError`. * **Outputs too**: `outputs.past_key_values`, `outputs.cache_params` and `outputs["past_key_values"]` still return the cache. Output classes can also still be built with the old field names (e.g. `CausalLMOutputWithPast(past_key_values=...)`), so most remote-code models keep working unchanged. * **Custom code**: models defined outside the library should rename their arguments to `cache`. Layers now call `cache.update(key_states, value_states, layer_idx, kwargs=kwargs)`, so custom `Cache` subclasses that override `update` should accept the extra `kwargs` argument. 🚨 `peft>=0.22.0` is now required. 📚 Docs: ### Multimodal Outputs Generative multimodal models now return shared output classes (`MultimodalBaseModelOutputWithPast`, `MultimodalCausalLMOutputWithPast`, and their MoE variants) instead of one output class per model. Code that checks for a model-specific output class should switch to these. * 🚨 Multimodal Model Output for generative LMs (#50379) by @zucchini-nlp `modeling_attn_mask_utils.py` has been removed. Every function in it had been deprecated in favor of `transformers.masking_utils`. Remote-code models that still import `_prepare_4d_causal_attention_mask` or `AttentionMaskConverter` from it must move to `transformers.masking_utils`. ### Other things * Remove deprecated and unused older mask API file (#50728) by @Cyrilvallez LayoutLMv3 (and the PP-DocLayoutV2 reading-order model that shares its code) now go through the attention interface, so SDPA and flex attention are supported. The relative position bias is built once per forward pass and passed to attention as `position_bias`. * 🚨 LayoutLMv3: support SDPA through the attention interface, build the relative position bias once (#50688) by @14H034160212 ## Cache Beyond the rename, this release adds static-cache support to assisted decoding and fixes `generate` with flex attention and a static cache. `StaticCache` now allocates values with the value states' dtype, and the cache is kept under activation checkpointing when gradients are off. The `is_linear` / `is_croppable` properties are fixed for hybrid linear/full-attention models, BigBird block-sparse decoding works with a KV cache, and KV sharing is restored for the Gemma 4 assistants. * Support static cache in assisted decoding (#49415) by @jiqing-feng * Simplify cache handling in generate (#50910) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix generate with flex attention and a static cache (#50864) by @tarekziade * Allocate the StaticCache values with the value states' dtype (#49554) by @qgallouedec * Keep the cache under activation checkpointing when gradients are off (#50890) by @qgallouedec * [cache] Fix is_linear property to correctly remove hybrid layers (#51030) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix is_croppable property for mixed linear-full attention classes (#51028) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix BigBird block-sparse decoding with a KV cache (#49984) by @jiqing-feng * fix(gemma4): Restore KV sharing for the Gemma 4 assistants and their targets (#50531) by @harshaljanjani * Fix Dory vocabulary resizing, loop validation, and last-loop static caching (#50982) by @shan18 * Fix device placement in `test_bc_cache_name_{forward,generate}` (#50757) by @ydshieh * Update test_dynamic_cache_hard expected values for A10G (#50822) by @ydshieh ## Generation Generation fixes cover sampled beam search (candidates are sorted again before finalization), constrained sampling (batch IDs are preserved), `generate` on MPS with encoder-decoder models, and `TextStreamer`, which no longer drops spaces or lags on text without spaces such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `StopStringCriteria` initializes faster, and its cache now actually hits. * Restore sorting of sampled beam candidates before finalization (#50754) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(generate): preserve batch IDs in constrained sampling (#50883) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Fix generate for mps and encoder-decoder models (#51032) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix TextStreamer dropping spaces sometimes (#51036) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix long lagging when streaming text without spaces and NJK chars (#36708) by @CNSeniorious000 * Speed up StopStringCriteria init and fix its cache never hitting (#50780) by @TheNetherWatcher ## Continuous batching Continuous batching now works under `torch.inference_mode()` and finds sharded key/value projections under any decoder path. The per-token memory estimate scales with the TP size, warmup handles async and static inputs correctly, and an out-of-bounds error in the top-k processor is fixed. * [CB] Scale the per-token memory estimate by the TP size (#48566) by @qgallouedec * Continuous batching: find the sharded key/value projections under any decoder path (#50366) by @qgallouedec * Fix continuous batching under torch.inference_mode() (#50863) by @tarekziade * [CB] Re-order the warmup block so async warms both sets of inputs (#50868) by @remi-or * Wait for each warmup forward before the next one rewrites the static inputs (#50353) by @qgallouedec * Fix out-of-bounds error in continuous batching top-k processor (#50282) by @khush-patel-09 * [CB] Replace test prompts with less ambiguous ones (#50876) by @remi-or ## Chat templates, parsing and serving Chat parsing gets a new `python-call-list` content parser, better handling of bare keys and duplicate XML arguments, and three further parser fixes. `apply_chat_template` accepts message objects, and assistant masks are correct with left truncation. `transformers serve` handles a missing Hub cache, lists loaded models in `/v1/models`, keeps local paths containing `@`, and keeps assistant content when `tool_calls` is empty. * [Chat Parsing] Add `python-call-list` content parser (#50619) by @nico-martin * [Chat Parsing] Quote bare keys that have whitespace around them with `unquoted_keys` (#50917) by @gagan-baghel * [Chat Parsing] Preserve array values when merging duplicate XML arguments (#50760) by @crunz-ailab * Fix three chat parsing bugs (#50655) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix apply_chat_template with message objects (#50818) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix assistant tokens mask with left truncation (#50758) by @yibol9768-alt * fix(chat templating): isolate concurrent assistant tracking (#50673) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Just a small improvement in jinja (#50635) by @zucchini-nlp * Accept argument types in parentheses in get_json_schema docstrings (#50745) by @miinimal * [serve] Handle missing Hub cache and include loaded models in /v1/models (#50663) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Preserve local model paths containing '@' in ModelManager (#50662) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Keep assistant content when tool_calls is null or empty (#50707) by @AabhasK ## Pipelines Multimodal pipelines now accept media-only inputs and string assistant prefills, keep Mistral prefills in Voxtral, stop mutating generation kwargs, and return chat messages as `input_text` when returning tensors. `pipeline` also respects a `device_map` that targets a single device. * fix(pipelines): support media-only inputs in AnyToAnyPipeline (#50856) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): support string assistant prefill in multimodal full-t… (#50679) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix: preserve Mistral prefill in Voxtral and multimodal pipelines (#50624) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): avoid mutating multimodal generation kwargs (#50786) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Return the chat messages as input_text when multimodal pipelines return tensors (#50816) by @burrows99 * Fix `pipeline` ignoring `device_map` when it targets a single device (#50645) by @wanhakim ## Vision Vision fixes cover Muse Glimmer's embedding order, GotOCR2 and Emu3 image sizes, Kimi video inputs, NemotronH Omni video forwarding, SAM3 RoPE precision in bf16, and DETR-family configs with `dilation=None`. SigLIP2 and LFM2-VL now process all images at once with tensor ops. Flash Attention is turned off for multimodal models whose image mask it would drop. * Fix Muse Glimmer vision embedding order (#50847) by @sid-rp * Fix GotOCR2 image size (#50810) by @guarin * Fix Emu3 image sizes after channel format conversion (#50615) by @stefanielizeth73-art * Kimi video fix (#50633) by @zucchini-nlp * Fix NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 video forwarding and MTP vision norm weight conversion (#49839) by @meatybobby * Keep SAM3's RoPE positions in fp32 when loading in bf16 (#50938) by @qgallouedec * Fix loading DETR-family configs that store dilation=None (#50934) by @sibisrinivasb * SigLIP2: compute the position-embedding resize for all images with tensor ops (#50736) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: run the projector on all images at once (#50734) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: integration expectations after #50734 (A10, MI300X) (#50923) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * Turn off Flash Attention support for multimodal models whose image mask it drops (#50724) by @albertvillanova ## Audio Audio fixes cover the OmniASR CTC blank token, Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs, Qwen3-ASR's `truncation=False` default, PeAudioVideo loading with timm 1.0.31, and the audio training examples. * Fix OmniASR CTC blank token ID (#51040) by @taking-lying-flat * Add missing past_key_values deprecation decorator to OmniASRForCondit… (#50983) by @RyanMullins * Fix Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs forwarding (#50616) by @remote-controlled-man * Restore `truncation=False` default for Qwen3-ASR audio (#50740) by @hmellor * Fixes PeAudioVideo model loading with timm 1.0.31. In that version, t… (#50862) by @sywangyi * FIx audio training examples. (#50672) by @ebezzam ## Quantization Dequantized models are now saved without the quantizer's weight conversions, and the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint are cast to the model's dtype. The quantization docs also get a standard template for each method. * Save dequantized models without the quantizer's weight conversions (#50271) by @qgallouedec * Cast the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint to the model's dtype (#50595) by @qgallouedec * Update inkling2 quant config (#50829) by @guarin * [docs] Standard template for quantization methods (#50848) by @stevhliu ## Parallelization FSDP2 modules are resharded before the optimizer is created, pipeline parallelism spreads layers more evenly, and TP sharding of tied weights is fixed. * Reshard FSDP2 modules before creating the optimizer (#50535) by @qgallouedec * [perf] Spread layer over PP more evenly (#50693) by @francesco-bertolotti * Fixes an issue related to TP sharding of tied weights (#50272) by @tengomucho ## Exporters Exported ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without `trust_remote_code`. Pickled `.pt2` programs, which can run arbitrary code when loaded, now require `trust_remote_code=True`. * Exporters: ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without trust_remote_code (#50886) by rawIngestions.titleRaw: huggingface/transformers v5.23.0 released
rawIngestions.contentRaw: # Release v5.23.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling2 Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters. It keeps the Inkling decoder (learned relative attention, short causal convolutions, mixture-of-experts layers) and adds block attention residuals, gated attention with a learned sink, and dynamic key/value convolutions. Images are encoded by a Perception Encoder-based vision transformer and projected into the language model embeddings, one embedding per 40x40 pixel patch. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/) * Add inkling2 (#50682) by @guarin in [#50682](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50682) ### JEV JEV is a decision head that scores single-token labels with a linear layer at the last token of the prompt, soft-capped like the logits of a language model head. `JevForDecision` is the model of the checkpoint and its head, and it reads the head files shipped next to the weights (`head.safetensors` and `judge_config.json` for JEV). The same head is also used by GEV and reads the 255 answer codes of pplx-decider and d3, and it can be run through the experimental `decision` pipeline or directly with `decide`. **Note:** JEV and the decision pipeline are currently experimental. Their APIs, configuration, and behavior may change as development continues. They should be used with caution in production environments. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/jev) * Add Jev + decision core (#50054) by @ArthurZucker in [#50054](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50054) ### LFM3 LFM3 is the third generation of Liquid Foundation Models from Liquid AI. Like LFM2, it is a hybrid architecture that combines gated short convolutions with grouped-query attention, with the attention layers split between full-attention and sliding-window layers. The attention layers apply RMSNorm to the query and key heads and gate their output with a per-head sigmoid. Every layer applies a sandwich norm to the operator and feed-forward outputs before the residual addition. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lfm3) * [Model] LFM3 Family: LFM3-Text (#50322) by @paulpak58 in [#50322](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50322) ### Dots 3 Note Preview Dots 3 Note Preview is a mixture-of-experts causal language model that accepts native text, image, video, and audio inputs. It uses a shared vision encoder for images and videos and a Whisper-style audio encoder, and both encoders project their outputs into the language model's hidden space before autoregressive text generation. BF16 and FP8 inference are supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dots3_note) * Add dots3-note Preview model support (#47844) by @miraclezqc in [#47844](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47844) ### LFM3-VL LFM3-VL is a vision-language model family from Liquid AI, built on the LFM3 language model. It takes images and videos at their native resolution together with text. It combines a hybrid vision encoder (a linear patchifier, gated depthwise 2D convolution layers, and bidirectional grouped-query attention layers with 2D rotary embeddings) with a projector and an LFM3 language model. The projector merges each 2x2 block of patch features into one language token through a layer norm and a two-layer MLP. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lfm3_vl) * [Model] LFM3 Family: LFM3-VL (#50392) by @paulpak58 in [#50392](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50392) ### IQuestCoder IQuest-Coder-V1 is a family of code language models developed by IQuest Lab, available in 7B, 14B and 40B sizes with base, instruct and thinking variants. Its architecture is the same as Llama, so the Transformers auto classes load it with LlamaModel and LlamaForCausalLM, and only IQuestCoderConfig is specific to IQuestCoder. The looped `IQuest-Coder-V1-*-Loop-*` checkpoints use a different architecture and aren't supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/iquestcoder) * Add IQuestCoder (#50579) by @hmellor in [#50579](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50579) ### InternLM3 InternLM3 is an 8B instruction-tuned language model developed by Shanghai AI Laboratory (checkpoint: internlm/internlm3-8b-instruct). Its architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load it with the Llama implementation (LlamaModel and LlamaForCausalLM), and only InternLM3Config is specific to InternLM3. The config names the attention biases `qkv_bias` and the output projection and MLP biases `bias`. InternLM3Config loads these as `attention_bias` and `mlp_bias` and requires them to be equal, as they are in the released checkpoints. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/internlm3) * Add InternLM3 (#50578) by @hmellor in [#50578](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50578) ## Breaking changes * 🚨 Remove the `ep_router` expert-parallel style (#49615) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 Run MXFP4 GPT-OSS experts through `ep_dispatch_experts` (#49613) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 `deepgemm_megamoe` EP implementation for DeepGEMM Mega MoE (#49606) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 Slim down `[audio]` to torchaudio + soundfile + soxr (drop librosa and phonemizer) (#50610) by @eustlb * 🚨 Deprecate Wav2Vec2ProcessorWithLM and pyctcdecode/kenlm LM decoding (#50408) by @eustlb * 🚨 Exporters: `ExportedModel`, Hub save/load, one backend registry (#50029) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 Move processing defaults to class (#49089) by @guarin * :rotating_light: [`kernels`] Bump version (#50307) by @vasqu * :rotating_light: Finally drop rope deltas from ModelOutput! (#50153) by @zucchini-nlp * 🚨 Safe-ize pi0 graphs (#50160) by @molbap * 🚨 [serve][breaking] update attn for mac users (#49730) by @SunMarc * 🚨 build and expand once the tp/ep_plan/fsdp_plan (#49527) by @3outeille ## Exporters: export, share and run any model on its backend (#50029, #50032, #50309, #50311) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b17b2ab-b2b8-4e34-a983-4a7177330e4e Every export now returns an `ExportedModel`. You call it like the original model (same kwargs, same output class), push it to the Hub, and load it back on the backend's own runtime. The same API covers Dynamo, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch. ```python from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer from transformers.exporters import ExportedModel, OnnxConfig, OnnxExporter model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("google/embeddinggemma-2") tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("google/embeddinggemma-2") inputs = tokenizer(["Exporters are here!"], return_tensors="pt") exported = OnnxExporter().export(model, inputs, OnnxConfig(dynamic=True, ort_fusions="cuda")) exported.push_to_hub("my-org/embeddinggemma-2-onnx") exported_model = ExportedModel.from_pretrained("my-org/embeddinggemma-2-onnx", device="cuda") outputs = exported_model(**inputs) # same output class as model(**inputs) ``` - **Fused for the runtime**: `OnnxConfig(ort_fusions="cpu" | "cuda" | "webgpu" | "dml")` rewrites the graph into ONNX Runtime's fused transformer ops at export time: attention, `GroupQueryAttention` over the KV cache, rotary, norms and `MoE`. OpenVINO exports now hit OpenVINO's fused CPU kernels for attention, RoPE, MoE experts and compressed int8/int4 weights, which makes decode 2.4–3.9× faster than before. - **Faster than `torch.compile`**: on EmbeddingGemma2 (8 × 128 tokens), ONNX Runtime with the TensorRT EP is 7.6× faster than eager PyTorch and 1.4× faster than `torch.compile` on an A100. OpenVINO is 4.1× faster than eager and 2.2× faster than `torch.compile` on a Xeon Platinum 8570 (4.9× and 2.6× with int8 weights). - **Shareable**: an export saves and loads like a model, optionally in a `subfolder` of the model repo. Its `export.json` records the config, input shapes, package versions and I/O names. Quantized exports (PT2E, NNCF, ONNX Runtime) save and run the same way. 🚨 `export()` returns an `ExportedModel`, and an ONNX program is an `onnx_ir.Model`. `OnnxConfig`'s and `OpenVINOConfig`'s `output_path` options are gone in favour of `save_pretrained`.
